note: Not a Y Combinator company: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/vercel returns 404, so no accelerator listed. Vercel (founded 2015 as ZEIT by Guillermo Rauch, still CEO) is an independent, VC-backed private company; prior rounds include a Series C ($102M, 2021) and a Series E ($250M, May 2024, $3.25B valuation) before the Series F ($300M, Sept 2025, $9.3B valuation) co-led by Accel and GIC. Sandbox is one product within the broader Vercel platform (Next.js hosting, v0, AI SDK), so any company-wide revenue figure (if found) would not isolate Sandbox's own revenue.
